summary.criterion: NOVEL requires a decision principle absent from the corpus and the literature; a recombination of corpus principles (BF on near-exact fits, an avoided residual band, an item-proportional target residual) with new thresholds or weights is KNOWN FAMILY, NEW PARAMETERS. Read arm-blind under opaque ids, before any judge call, with each program's synthetic decision profile (scripts/profile_rules.py) and the same profiles of the corpus (results/corpus_profiles.json).

B10.rule_in_words: First Fit, except that a bin whose residual after packing would fall in a fixed band (B10: 6..20, B11: 7..23) is scored below every other bin, so the item goes to the first bin outside the band (a new bin if needed).
B10.family: ab family (Herrmann & Pallez, arXiv 2510.27353): avoided residual band with FF base; FF also inside the tight class; new thresholds

B01.rule_in_words: Best fit among near-exact fits; residuals in a band (about 5-25 / 7-23, or item-dependent for B09/B13) lose to a new bin; above the band a best-fit-like order relative to the band edge (B01 even prefers a residual just above 23 over an exact fit).
B01.family: ab-BF family (2510.27353): tight fits by BF, avoided band, BF base above it; new thresholds

B05.rule_in_words: Best fit with a quadratic penalty r^2 for residuals below the item size and a linear penalty above it, so medium residuals just below the item size lose to a new bin (an emergent item-dependent band); B25/B34 also penalise very large residuals (>10*item, >3*item), which for small items makes opening a new bin a last resort.
B05.family: ab family (2510.27353) with item-dependent band edges; BF base

B00.rule_in_words: Near-exact fits first (residual 0-2); residuals below about 10 penalised (an avoided band); otherwise prefer the bin whose residual is closest to the item size (an |r - item| term weighted by utilisation), with small weight differences between candidates.
B00.family: EoH run-3 family (published OBP population: tight fit, then target residual ~ item) combined with the ab band; new weights

B03.rule_in_words: A Gaussian bump in the capacity ratio rho = bins/item times a sinusoid in rho: near-exact fits score highest, a band of residuals of roughly 0.15-0.5 item scores zero (ties resolved by first index, i.e. First Fit among them), and a secondary peak sits at an item-proportional residual (~0.1-0.5 item, or ~1.3-1.5 item for B20, B21, B31); B21's sinusoid also skips residuals near odd half-multiples of the item.
B03.family: item-proportional target-residual family (EoH run 3; MCTS-AHD targets ~1.5 item) with an ab-style avoided band; FF tie-break

B07.rule_in_words: Tiered bonuses with item-proportional thresholds: residual below 0.1-0.2 item gets the largest bonus, residual in (0.5-0.6, 0.9] item a smaller bonus, residual above 0.9 item a penalty; inside tiers a log-based best-fit-like order (B37 orders its tight tier worst-fit-first, which only matters for residuals below 0.1 item).
B07.family: c12-style tiered gap scores (FunSearch OR heuristic) / ab band with item-proportional tier edges
